messages:
Maya: Hey team — quick design check. Thinking of moving the 'Import sample project' CTA out of the persistent top banner and into the first-run checklist as a step. Also proposing role-aware checklist variants (dev / pm / infra). Pros/cons? Kevin: I prefer checklist item. Banner feels loud and competes with product tours. But for devs we need a fast path to import — maybe a collapsed 'Get started' that expands to a one-click import. Sam: Accessibility nit: if it becomes a checklist item we must ensure correct focus order and SR announcements when the import finishes. Also keyboard-only users need a clear tab flow. Olivia: Mock uploaded to Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123/role-aware-checklist — shows import inline under Step 2 (Project). Inline secondary button with subtle icon. Maya: Good point on cadence. Also need to handle Dedicated/Private customers who can't access hosted samples. We could surface a variant: 'Add sample (from registry)' with a dropdown. Kevin: +1 to the registry variant. Also add eventing: track which path user takes (banner vs checklist vs registry). aria-bot: Accessibility scan suggestion: Use role="list" on the checklist container and role="listitem" for each step. The import control should have aria-label="Import sample project — opens import modal" and the modal should trap focus. Sam: Example snippet for button ARIA: ```html
This will install a demo app into your workspace
``` Sam: Also ensure an aria-live polite region announces: 'Sample project imported' after success. Olivia: Microcopy question: change CTA from 'Import sample' to 'Add sample project' or keep shorter? I think 'Add sample project' is clearer for non-devs. Maya: I like 'Add sample project' + tooltip 'Installs a demo app into your workspace'. Keeps it clear and reduces 'import' jargon. Kevin: Let's A/B test wording and placement. I'll add to the experiments board and set two variants: (A) checklist item 'Add sample project' (B) compact banner 'Quick import'. Maya: Can we also add a keyboard shortcut hint (press I) next to the checklist step for power users? Sam: Make sure shortcut is optional and discoverable in the command palette rather than as an inline keypress hint for accessibility. Kevin: Agreed. I'll file a task: EXP-347. deploy-bot: CI: Started pipeline for branch role-checklist (build #42). ETA ~12m. :rocket: Olivia: Thanks — I'll update the Figma with the aria labels and two microcopy variants. LMK if you want a short prototype for usability testing this week.
